messages:
infra-oncall: HEADS UP - seeing rising ECC errors on gpunode-ptl-03 in eu-west-2. Node rebooted twice in last 30m, now showing ~70% degraded capacity in pool-gpu-b. Evicted 6 pods.

lara: grabbing logs and cordoning the node now. running `kubectl cordon gpunode-ptl-03` and then drain.

lara: telemetry snapshot — ECC correctable count jumped from 0 -> 14 in ~18m, then kernel softlock before reboot. attaching dmesg excerpt below.

lara: dmesg excerpt:
```
[  123.456789] EDAC MC0: CPU0: CE detected, PFA event
[  123.457001] nvdimm: ecc: corrected 14 errors
[  124.000112] gpu: ptl: ECC: correctable parity errors: 14
[  124.000289] kernel: softlockup - CPU#2 stuck for 22s
```

sam: Oncall — do we have spare capacity in eu-west-1 or eu-west-3 to take traffic? If not, we should immediately shift non-latency-critical routes or spin up burst capacity in us-east as fallback.

raj: eu-west-2 is low on spare GPUs this sprint (reserved capacity). eu-west-1 has 8 spare GPUs we can use. Opening incident ticket INC-4521 and will coordinate traffic shift.

ophelia: Proposed remediation plan:
1) cordon + drain gpunode-ptl-03 (done by @lara)
2) reprovision replacement node image gpu-node-2026-03 with mem-test enabled
3) if corrected ECC continues after 3 reboots -> escalate to HW RMA and mark node as DO NOT SCHEDULE
4) immediate traffic shift: 30% of pool-gpu-b to eu-west-1, remaining traffic gradual over 6h window

lara: Drain command I used:
```
kubectl drain gpunode-ptl-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force
```
Most pods drained cleanly, 2 long-running eval jobs blocked (aborted them). Node successfully cordoned.

deploy-bot: autoscaler: launching 4 spot GPU instances in eu-west-1 for pool-gpu-b-shift (policy: burst-spot) :rocket:

sre-lead: Noted on cost — spots reduce unit cost but cross-region egress and replication will increase monthly spend. Quick estimate: shifting 30% -> ~+$2.1k/day additional egress and instance costs. Finance FYI.

lara: Reprovision started (image gpu-node-2026-03). Monitoring ECC counters at 5m intervals. If we still see correctable errors after 3 reboots/reprovisions, we'll tag node for RMA.

monitor-bot: ALERT: pool-gpu-b.available_gpus decreased from 42 -> 18 in 8m. text-gen latency P95 increased 18%.

raj: Action items assigned: @lara owns node replacement and logs; @sam coordinate traffic routing + DNS failover; @ophelia to run rollback playbook if latency >25% sustained for 10m. I'll update INC-4521 with timeline.

infra-oncall: Thanks all — standing by for updates. Next update in 10m or immediately on major state change. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
